title: NetherBlocker
description: Block Nether access with a fully configurable real-time Action Bar countdown.
body:
**NetherBlocker** is a lightweight, easy-to-use plugin that allows server administrators to block access to the Nether dimension for a specific amount of time. Whether you want to prevent players from rushing to the Nether on a new season or just want to create a grand opening event, this plugin is for you.

It displays a clean, constant Action Bar countdown for all players, keeping them informed about when the Nether will be accessible.

## **✨ Features**
- **Fully Configurable**: Set the exact time (days, hours, minutes, seconds) in the config.yml.
  
- **Constant Action Bar**: A live, smooth countdown that stays on the screen without flickering.
  
- **Automatic Unlock**: Once the time expires, the plugin automatically allows Nether access and displays a persistent "Open" message.
  
- **Instant Reload**: Apply changes to your configuration or force-reset the timer in-game with a single command.
  
- **Custom Messages**: Easily translate or customize all plugin messages using color codes (&).
  
- **Performance-friendly**: Optimized code that uses minimal resources.
## **How to use**
- **Install**: Drop the NetherBlocker.jar into your /plugins folder and restart your server.
  
- **Configure**: Edit the config.yml in /plugins/NetherBlocker/ to set your desired time and messages.
  
- **Reload**: Use /netherblocker reload to apply your changes or reset the countdown.

-  **Enjoy**: Your players will see the countdown in their action bar automatically!
##    Commands & Permissions
/netherblocker reload - Reloads the configuration and forces a timer update.
Permission: netherblocker.admin

##  ⚙️ Requirements
Minecraft Version: 1.16.5 - 1.21.10

Java Version: Java 17 or higher.
